papers.title: Restless Bandits with Many Arms: Beating the Central Limit Theorem
papers.abstract: We consider finite-horizon restless bandits with multiple pulls per period, which play an important role in recommender systems, active learning, revenue management, and many other areas. While an optimal policy can be computed, in principle, using dynamic programming, the computation required scales exponentially in the number of arms $N$. Thus, there is substantial value in understanding the performance of index policies and other policies that can be computed efficiently for large $N$. We study the growth of the optimality gap, i.e., the loss in expected performance compared to an optimal policy, for such policies in a classical asymptotic regime proposed by Whittle in which $N$ grows while holding constant the fraction of arms that can be pulled per period. Intuition from the Central Limit Theorem and the tightest previous theoretical bounds suggest that this optimality gap should grow like $O(\sqrt{N})$. Surprisingly, we show that it is possible to outperform this bound. We characterize a non-degeneracy condition and a wide class of novel practically-computable policies, called fluid-priority policies, in which the optimality gap is $O(1)$. These include most widely-used index policies. When this non-degeneracy condition does not hold, we show that fluid-priority policies nevertheless have an optimality gap that is $O(\sqrt{N})$, significantly generalizing the class of policies for which convergence rates are known. We demonstrate that fluid-priority policies offer state-of-the-art performance on a collection of restless bandit problems in numerical experiments.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究多臂老虎机问题的策略改进，与FEA替代模型或生物力学优化无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper contains no FEA, surrogate modeling, biomechanics, or implant design; it is a pure reinforcement learning theory paper.

summary_zh.motivation: 大规模多臂老虎机策略计算复杂，需高效近似策略。
summary_zh.method: 提出流体优先级策略，理论分析最优间隙增长阶数。
summary_zh.result: 非退化条件下最优间隙为O(1)，一般条件下为O(√N)。
summary_zh.validation: 数值实验验证流体优先级策略性能。

summary_en.motivation: Computing optimal policies for large-scale restless bandits is computationally intractable, motivating the study of efficient index policies.
summary_en.method: We propose fluid-priority policies and theoretically analyze the growth rate of the optimality gap under Whittle's asymptotic regime.
summary_en.result: Under a non-degeneracy condition, the optimality gap is O(1), surpassing the intuitive O(√N) bound; otherwise it remains O(√N).
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on benchmark restless bandit problems demonstrate state-of-the-art performance of fluid-priority policies.

papers.title: A brief note on understanding neural networks as Gaussian processes
papers.abstract: As a generalization of the work in [Lee et al., 2017], this note briefly discusses when the prior of a neural network output follows a Gaussian process, and how a neural-network-induced Gaussian process is formulated. The posterior mean functions of such a Gaussian process regression lie in the reproducing kernel Hilbert space defined by the neural-network-induced kernel. In the case of two-layer neural networks, the induced Gaussian processes provide an interpretation of the reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces whose union forms a Barron space.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文纯粹是神经网络与高斯过程之间理论联系的数学讨论，完全不涉及仿真代理建模、约束处理、不确定性量化或生物力学设计。
llm.why_not_core: The paper provides only theoretical connections between neural networks and Gaussian processes without any application to surrogate modeling, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or biomechanical design.

summary_zh.motivation: 解释神经网络输出如何被视为高斯过程。
summary_zh.method: 通过数学推导展示神经网络诱导的核及其再生核希尔伯特空间。
summary_zh.result: 两层神经网络的后验均值位于Barron空间的子集中。
summary_zh.validation: 纯理论推导，无实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: This note aims to clarify when and how neural networks can be interpreted as Gaussian processes.
summary_en.method: The derivation shows how a neural network induces a kernel and how the prior over network outputs becomes a Gaussian process.
summary_en.result: For two-layer neural networks, the posterior mean functions lie in a reproducing kernel Hilbert space within the Barron space.
summary_en.validation: The work is purely theoretical with no experimental validation.

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning Compensated Extended Kalman Filter for Attitude Estimation
papers.abstract: Inertial measurement units are widely used in different fields to estimate the attitude. Many algorithms have been proposed to improve estimation performance. However, most of them still suffer from 1) inaccurate initial estimation, 2) inaccurate initial filter gain, and 3) non-Gaussian process and/or measurement noise. In this paper, we leverage reinforcement learning to compensate for the classical extended Kalman filter estimation, i.e., to learn the filter gain from the sensor measurements. We also analyse the convergence of the estimate error. The effectiveness of the proposed algorithm is validated on both simulated data and real data.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文与有限元代理建模、约束处理、不确定性量化及植入物设计方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on attitude estimation using reinforcement learning and extended Kalman filter, with no connection to FEA surrogate modeling, expensive simulation sampling, constraints handling, or biomechanics design.

summary_zh.method: 利用强化学习补偿扩展卡尔曼滤波的增益。
summary_zh.result: 在仿真和真实数据上验证了算法的有效性。
summary_zh.validation: 使用仿真数据和真实数据进行验证。

summary_en.motivation: To improve attitude estimation from inertial measurements under non-Gaussian noise and uncertain initial conditions.
summary_en.method: A reinforcement learning agent is used to learn the filter gain of an extended Kalman filter from sensor data.
summary_en.result: The proposed algorithm demonstrates improved estimation accuracy on both simulated and real IMU datasets.
summary_en.validation: Validation performed on simulated data with controlled noise and real-world IMU recordings.

papers.title: ReDAL: Region-based and Diversity-aware Active Learning for Point Cloud Semantic Segmentation
papers.abstract: Despite the success of deep learning on supervised point cloud semantic segmentation, obtaining large-scale point-by-point manual annotations is still a significant challenge. To reduce the huge annotation burden, we propose a Region-based and Diversity-aware Active Learning (ReDAL), a general framework for many deep learning approaches, aiming to automatically select only informative and diverse sub-scene regions for label acquisition. Observing that only a small portion of annotated regions are sufficient for 3D scene understanding with deep learning, we use softmax entropy, color discontinuity, and structural complexity to measure the information of sub-scene regions. A diversity-aware selection algorithm is also developed to avoid redundant annotations resulting from selecting informative but similar regions in a querying batch. Extensive experiments show that our method highly outperforms previous active learning strategies, and we achieve the performance of 90% fully supervised learning, while less than 15% and 5% annotations are required on S3DIS and SemanticKITTI datasets, respectively. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/tsunghan-wu/ReDAL.

papers.title: Fundamentals of 3D Bioprinting Technology
papers.abstract: 3D bioprinting consists in the printing of synthetic 3D structures used as biomaterials, along with cells, growth factors, and other components necessary to create a new functional organ. This technology can be applied to regenerative medicine and tissue engineering to treat diseases, test pharmaceuticals, and study the mechanisms underlying diseases. Currently, there are three basic types of 3D bioprinting technologies: laser, droplet, and extrusion. Laser-based bioprinters (LBP) use laser energy to induce the bioink transfer. Droplet-based bioprinters (DBP) expel the bioink dropwise throughout a nozzle. Inkjet-based bioprinters are the DBP commonly used for biological proposes, it is also a non-contact approach that releases controlled volumes of bioink drops in a continuous (CIJ) or under demand way (DOD). The extrusion-based bioprinters (EBB) also use pressure to force out the bioink, but consists of a syringe containing the material with a pneumatic or mechanical mechanism as dispensing system. Comparing to the other bioprinting technologies, extrusion printing is the most versatile and is indicated for bioprinting of scaffold prosthetic implants. The bioinks used in 3D bioprinting are composed of a solution with a biomaterial mixture, usually encapsulating cells. Biomaterials are essential components of 3D bioprinting technologies because they provide scaffolds as supporting physical structures for cells to attach, grow, differentiate, and develop into tissues. Numerous cell types have been used in 3D bioprinting to build cardiovascular, musculoskeletal, neural, hepatic, adipose and skin tissues. Bioprinting is an emerging technology that has the ability to revolutionize the way we address many health issues.
papers.venue: Journal of Bioengineering Technologies and Health

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文是3D生物打印的综述，未涉及AI或机器学习，与用户的研究方向不直接相关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a general review of 3D bioprinting technologies without any integration of AI/ML, lacking experimental validation or autonomous decision-making relevant to AI-driven bioprinting.

summary_zh.motivation: 介绍3D生物打印的基本原理与技术类型。
summary_zh.method: 综述了激光、喷墨和挤出三种生物打印技术及其生物墨水组成。
summary_zh.result: 总结了不同生物打印技术的优缺点及在再生医学中的应用。
summary_zh.validation: 基于文献综述，未进行实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To provide a foundational overview of 3D bioprinting technologies and their applications in tissue engineering.
summary_en.method: This review categorizes bioprinting into laser-based, droplet-based, and extrusion-based methods, describing their mechanisms and bioink requirements.
summary_en.result: Extrusion bioprinting is identified as the most versatile for scaffold fabrication, while various cell types have been used to engineer multiple tissue types.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation is reported; the paper synthesizes existing literature.
